name: byte_swap
text:
local z_word_t byte_swap(word)
    z_word_t word;
{
#if W == 8
    return
        (word & 0xff00000000000000) >> 56 |
        (word & 0xff000000000000) >> 40 |
        (word & 0xff0000000000) >> 24 |
        (word & 0xff00000000) >> 8 |
        (word & 0xff000000) << 8 |
        (word & 0xff0000) << 24 |
        (word & 0xff00) << 40 |
        (word & 0xff) << 56;
#else   /* W == 4 */
    return
        (word & 0xff000000) >> 24 |
        (word & 0xff0000) >> 8 |
        (word & 0xff00) << 8 |
        (word & 0xff) << 24;
#endif
}
